content: {"reasoning":"The required authorization is missing, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. An appeal has already been filed, but no current payer response supports another appeal, an information submission, or a corrected claim. The prior CO-197 denial does not establish patient liability despite the remaining deductible, and writing off the balance is premature while the appeal outcome is unresolved. No available automated action can properly progress the claim, so specialist follow-up is necessary.","action":"escalate"}
